title: Tesla Battery Health Degradation Trend
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:charge charge_pct>=95
| eval range_at_full=rated_range_km/(charge_pct/100)
| timechart span=1mon avg(range_at_full) as full_range_km
| eventstats first(full_range_km) as new_range
| eval degradation_pct=round(100*(new_range-full_range_km)/new_range,1)
description: Estimates your Tesla's full-charge range each month from near-full charges and trends how much battery capacity has faded since new.
value: Battery degradation affects resale value and daily range; a monthly trend gives you an honest number instead of range-anxiety guesswork.
implementation: Ingest Tesla charge state (via TeslaMate or the Fleet API) into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and watch the degradation percentage.
visualization: Line chart of estimated full-charge range per month with a degradation percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how much your electric car's battery has worn down over time, so you know the true range you can count on.
